pre_parse_gates: file type and MIME agree with allowlist
parser runs with no network and no code execution
sanitization: remove NUL and disallowed control characters while recording counts
normalize Unicode to NFC while retaining original hash
treat URLs/emails as inert strings and never resolve them
escape spreadsheet-formula prefixes on any reviewer export
reject embedded binary payloads or markup requiring rendering
provenance_and_labeling: preserve source row identifier and immutable source hash
keep evidence source separate from content artifact
never map registry membership, warning presence, malware detection or absence to a label
require primary review, blind second review and reconciliation for real-world labels
keep external holdout identities disjoint and sealed
